title: MECHANCS OF FRACTURE ＆ FATIGUE
description: Elastic stresses at a crack; energy and stress intensity criteria for crack growth; effect of plastic zone at the crack; fracture testing applications. Fatigue characterization by stress-life and strain-life; damage index; crack propagation; fail safe and safe life analysis.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Undergraduate mechanics of solids course.
